sections.title: Common Challenges Hospitals Face Without Hospital Management Software

items.title: Manual Record Management
text: Paper files and disconnected systems make patient information difficult to access, resulting in delays and duplicate records.

items.title: Appointment Scheduling Issues
text: Managing appointments manually often leads to long waiting times, missed appointments, and inefficient resource utilization.

items.title: Billing & Revenue Leakage
text: Manual billing processes increase the chances of billing errors, missed charges, insurance disputes, and revenue loss.

items.title: Poor Department Coordination
text: Lack of integration between pharmacy, laboratory, billing, and clinical departments slows down hospital operations.

items.title: Inventory & Pharmacy Problems
text: Tracking medicines and medical supplies manually often results in stock shortages, expired inventory, and unnecessary expenses.

items.title: Limited Business Insights
text: Without analytics and reporting tools, healthcare administrators struggle to make informed operational decisions.
